name: Multica Notify
description: Fans signed issue/task events out to Apprise, ntfy, or any webhook. Requires the companion multica-notify bridge service; see https://github.com/bg9ezn/multica-notify.

hooks.name: Issue status notifications
hooks.description: Receives issue.status_changed deliveries and forwards the ones matching the bridge filter to the configured channels.

hooks.name: Task lifecycle notifications
hooks.description: Receives task.completed / task.failed deliveries and forwards them per the bridge filter.

hooks.name: Daily heartbeat
hooks.description: Scheduled no-op delivery used to prove the whole path (Multica -> bridge -> channels) is alive.
